links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT answers to repeated identical questions over time
links.effect: Answers varied over time when entered repeatedly; only 3 of 12 answers were identical, showing no to low reproducibility.
links.quote: The answers of ChatGPT varied over time when entered repeatedly and only three out of 12 answers were identical, showing no reproducibility to low reproducibility.

links.outcome: Content correctness and patient-harm risk of ChatGPT drug answers versus pharmacist reference
links.effect: Only 13 of 50 answers were correct, sufficient for management and no risk; 38% (n=19) false, 36% (n=18) partly correct; high risk of harm in 26% (n=13).
links.quote: Overall, only 13 of 50 answers provided correct content and had enough information to initiate management with no risk of patient harm.

links.outcome: Presence of references/citations in ChatGPT drug information answers
links.effect: No references were provided for the answers.
links.quote: The majority of answers were either false (38%, n=19) or had partly correct content (36%, n=18) and no references were provided.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, reproducibility, and clinical safety risk of ChatGPT answering drug-related questions, rated by hospital pharmacists, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
